reader.requirement: At COBOL-85, a PAGE HEADING (PH) or PAGE FOOTING (PF) report group is refused in a report whose RD has no PAGE clause, and accepted (and presented) when the RD has one.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses at 85 the 2002 PAGE forms (no page limit, a width), so a width-only PAGE clause cannot make a PH/PF legal at 85

reader.edition-search: BindGroupType itself has no edition test: grep of DialectLevel/Edition.Year/Constructs in the member found none; the PH/PF screen is the same code at every edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the screen is the same; at 85 the PAGE clause always carries the page limit, so 'PAGE clause specified' equals Paged
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f30_06 exercises only the accepted half (PH and PF with a PAGE clause); the refusal without a PAGE clause is not exercised

probes.printed: COBOL0899 'TYPE PageHeading requires a PAGE clause' and 'TYPE PageFooting requires a PAGE clause' (plus COBOL2199 for the relative first LINE of a PF, §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR9)
probes.expected: PH and PF both refused without a PAGE clause

probes.printed: one COBOL0899 on R2's PH only; R1 (PAGE LIMIT 20) accepted
probes.expected: the rule is per report: only the unpaged R2's PH refused

probes.printed: COBOL0900 'the PAGE clause without its page limit requires COBOL-2002' and COBOL0899 on the PF
probes.expected: the 2002 width-only PAGE form refused at 85; PF refused

probes.printed: G1 PC 1 LC 003 / G2 PC 1 LC 004 / T PC 1 LC 019 / [PH] [DE] [DE] [PF]; EXPECT: MATCH
probes.expected: PH and PF accepted and presented with a PAGE clause
